steps.instruction: Test dryness where the paint is thickest, not the edges. Any drag or smell of solvent means wait.
Choose transparent pigments only — check the tube's opacity tag in your inventory. An opaque pigment thinned with medium is a veil, not a glaze.
Mix glaze piles thin: a nut of transparent color loaded with medium, no white. Preview the shift on your photo before committing brush to canvas.
Glaze shadows and mid-tones to deepen and unify; leave the lights alone or the painting sinks. Work one region fully, then stop — a second pass goes over dry, not into wet.
Wipe back immediately with a soft rag anywhere the glaze pools or the value drops more than one step.
